answer_1.quote: we combine both OCR's visual recognition and LLM's linguistic expertise to predict damaged content in the Damaged Content Prediction (DCP) stage.

answer_2.quote: For damaged content prediction, Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy metrics are adopted.

answer_4.quote: we conduct two user studies (Style Consistency and Overall Quality) with 20 participants to evaluate restoration quality. Additionally, we invite historians to evaluate a randomly selected set of 30 samples...
answer_4.guideline: participants are asked to score the font style similarity between restored and original regions on a 1-5 scale... for overall quality, participants are asked to consider font style similarity, background integration, and character accuracy, then select the best result
